description: One ledger account this budget tracks: what was budgeted, what actually happened, and how far apart the two are. The last three columns are computed by refresh_budget — nothing here is typed by hand.

fields.label: Account
fields.description: The general ledger account this line tracks. One row per account — get_budget_variance_report reports a duplicate rather than silently summing two rows into one answer.

fields.label: Budgeted Amount
fields.description: What this account was planned to move by, for the whole fiscal year.

fields.label: Actual Amount
fields.description: Year-to-date GL movement on this account, as of the last refresh_budget call. Read-only — computed, never typed.

fields.label: Variance Amount
fields.description: actual_amount minus budgeted_amount. Positive means the account moved MORE than budgeted; negative means less.

fields.label: Variance %
fields.description: variance_amount as a percentage of budgeted_amount. Zero when budgeted_amount is zero, since a percentage of nothing is undefined rather than zero — read variance_amount for the honest figure on a line with no budget.

fields.label: Threshold %
fields.description: How far variance_pct may move before this line counts as a breach. Warning at 1-2x this number, Critical past 2x. Ten percent is the shipped default and any line may set its own.

name: Budget Line Item
